result.instructions: Tools for Axiom, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which datasets do we store logs in, and how long do we keep them?"; "Show me the 500 errors from our checkout service in the last hour, grouped by route."; "Which monitors fired in the last 24 hours, and what did they notify?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Axiom data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run axiom_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run axiom_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run axiom_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. axiom_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: axiom_list_datasets
tools.title: List datasets
tools.description: List the datasets this token can read, with their edge deployment, retention and labels. Good first call to find dataset names and ids. Axiom API: GET /v2/datasets.

tools.name: axiom_get_dataset
tools.title: Get dataset
tools.description: Get one dataset: its name, kind, retention, edge deployment and labels. Axiom API: GET /v2/datasets/{dataset_id}.

tools.name: axiom_list_dataset_fields
tools.title: List dataset fields
tools.description: List the fields (columns) of one dataset with their types. Use it before writing an APL query. Axiom API: GET /v2/datasets/{dataset_id}/fields.

tools.name: axiom_query
tools.title: Run APL query
tools.description: Run an APL (Axiom Processing Language) query on this account's edge deployment and return the rows as a table. Example: ['app-logs'] | where status >= 500 | summarize count() by bin_auto(_time). Results over 150,000 characters are cut. Axiom API: POST /v1/query/_apl?format=tabular on the edge host.

apl.description: APL query text. Quote dataset names in brackets, for example ['app-logs'] | limit 20.

startTime.description: Start of the time range, RFC 3339 or relative such as now-1h.

endTime.description: End of the time range (default now).

tools.name: axiom_list_monitors
tools.title: List monitors
tools.description: List the monitors (alerts) in this organization with their queries, thresholds and state. Axiom API: GET /v2/monitors.

tools.name: axiom_get_monitor
tools.title: Get monitor
tools.description: Get one monitor: its query, thresholds, schedule and notifiers. Axiom API: GET /v2/monitors/{id}.

tools.name: axiom_get_monitor_history
tools.title: Get monitor history
tools.description: List the notifications sent or the runs of one monitor in a time range. Axiom API: GET /v2/monitors/{id}/history.

startTime.description: Start of the range, RFC 3339 (required by Axiom).

endTime.description: End of the range, RFC 3339 (required by Axiom). Must not be before startTime.

tools.name: axiom_list_dashboards
tools.title: List dashboards
tools.description: List the dashboards in this organization. Axiom API: GET /v2/dashboards.

tools.name: axiom_get_dashboard
tools.title: Get dashboard
tools.description: Get one dashboard by its uid, including its charts and queries. Axiom API: GET /v2/dashboards/uid/{uid}.

tools.name: axiom_list_saved_queries
tools.title: List saved queries
tools.description: List the saved (starred) APL queries of this organization. Axiom API: GET /v2/apl-starred-queries.

tools.name: axiom_list_annotations
tools.title: List annotations
tools.description: List chart annotations (deployments, incidents and other marked events), optionally by dataset and time range. Axiom API: GET /v2/annotations.

datasets.description: Only annotations on these dataset names.

start.description: Only events after this RFC 3339 time (needs end; range up to 100 days).

end.description: Only events before this RFC 3339 time (needs start).

tools.name: axiom_create_annotation
tools.title: Create annotation
tools.description: Mark an event (for example a production deployment) on the charts of the given datasets. Adds a new annotation each call; it does not change existing ones. Axiom API: POST /v2/annotations.

datasets.description: Dataset names where the annotation appears on charts.

title.description: Short title shown on the chart.

time.description: When the event happened (default: now). Cannot be in the future.

endTime.description: End of the event, if it has a duration.

url.description: Related link, for example a pull request.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Axiom
prompts.description: What you can do with Axiom here, with example requests to try.
